entries.zh: 约定；以言相许、口头允诺
entries.en: to agree by giving one's word; to promise

entries.zh: 约定；立约（同字「约」异读重出）
entries.en: to agree by word; to contract
entries.notes: 与第1条同词头同字「约」，仅闽南音读不同（yǎge），释义同。

entries.zh: 断定；决断、一言敲定
entries.en: to decide; to settle conclusively
entries.notes: 西语栏「ut el que lugar」难以解读，释义主要依据汉字「断」与对音 toān。

entries.zh: 量；测量、估量
entries.en: to measure; to estimate

entries.zh: 以交情调和、修好；央托、托人办事
entries.en: to reconcile through friendship; to entrust / commission someone
entries.notes: 字形「雍」与音 iang/òng 及西语 encargar 三栏未尽互证，兼取「修好」与「托付」二义（后者疑为「央」字）。

entries.zh: 谋计；密谋、暗中定计
entries.en: to scheme; to conspire secretly

entries.zh: 讲价；议定价钱、商定价钱
entries.en: to bargain over the price; to agree on a price

entries.zh: 缚定；就既定事项立约定死、定牢不变
entries.en: to bind down; to settle a fixed agreement on a determinate matter
entries.notes: 西语缩写 mt′/concier′ 难确解，据「缚定」推断为「特定事项定为固定」之义。

entries.zh: 缚做长年：立约雇为长工、按年受雇的长期佣工
entries.en: to bind/hire someone as a long-term (yearly) hired servant
entries.notes: 闽南栏「长」字调符 T99 污损；西语「por emano」疑为「por un año（按年）」，释义据汉字「缚做长年」推定。

entries.zh: 缚戏：订戏、约戏班演出（订定演戏）
entries.en: to engage a theatrical troupe; to contract a performance
entries.notes: 西语残句「come diante por juntos」难解，释义据「缚戏」＝订戏班推定。

entries.zh: 诈谋；设谋行骗、共谋坑骗
entries.en: to plot deceit; to scheme in order to deceive

entries.zh: 相处；彼此交往、合得来
entries.en: to get along (with one another); to associate

entries.zh: 处准；裁定应允、判定准许
entries.en: to settle and grant approval; to decide in favor
entries.notes: 西语「aslindar」非常规词形（疑为 asentar/asignar 之误写），释义据「处准」推定。

entries.zh: 处顾；照管、照料料理
entries.en: to take care of; to look after
entries.notes: 西语「asogulto」难解，官话对音第二音节「xuēn」与「顾」不尽合，释义依「处顾」推定。

entries.zh: 约束；受约制、循约而行
entries.en: to be bound by agreement; to keep to agreed terms

entries.zh: 断约；言定、口头立约
entries.en: to settle by word; to agree verbally

entries.zh: 通谋；串通合谋
entries.en: to conspire together; to plot jointly

entries.zh: 同谋；合谋、共谋其事
entries.en: to conspire; to plot together as accomplices

entries.zh: 鉴定；勘验判定、验看而定
entries.en: to appraise; to examine and determine
entries.notes: 西语缩写「c′te yando」难确解，据汉字「监定（鉴定）」与官话对音 jiāndìng 推定。

entries.zh: 齐整；收拾整齐、使之齐备一致
entries.en: to put in order; to make neat and uniform

entries.zh: 成就；办成、使之成全
entries.en: to accomplish; to bring to fruition
entries.notes: 西语「venivanell」疑为残词难解，释义据「成就」推定。

entries.zh: 相约；互相邀约、约在某处会面
entries.en: to make an appointment with one another; to arrange to meet
entries.notes: 闽南栏首字作「sia[g]」且调符 T99 污损难辨；释义据汉字「相约」与官话对音 siǎng yō。
